supplied_boundary: The hidden customts engine supplies conveyor transport, one held modifier, slow manual cakes, three machines with six editable trays, comparison display and three orders per round. Arithmetic and comparison handlers report exact learner results; nonmutating observers may reject only and never repair quantities, Boolean values or learner variables.
starter_policy: A comment-only template resource and starter main.ts use // Cake Factory while supplying no executable learner code, variables or solution events.
hint_policy: Each numbered construction step1-12 has its complete current-event Blocks example. Comparison hints introduce leftCakes, rightCakes and ready, with ready initialized false.
comparison_policy: Comparison states use ==, < and > metadata and Boolean output; they are excluded from arithmetic counts.
claim_boundary: The manifest declares ownership, the 320×240 inline boundary, machine/tray counts and expected outputs. It does not establish compilation, native Blocks fidelity, gameplay, learner quality or publication readiness.
